snippet.title: My Little Puppy – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
My Little Puppy jumps onto Nintendo Switch digitally on May 29, 2026, and physically in June!

Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi was once an abandoned dog. Then one day, a miracle happened! Bong-gu was adopted by a scruffy man who cherished Bong-gu. From that point on, Bong-gu lived out his remaining days just like any other dog would: playing tug-of-war, running around, eating, sleeping and enjoying his newfound life. In the end, Bong-gu crossed the rainbow bridge.
 
One day in doggy heaven, Bong-gu awakened from his nap to a familiar scent. His dad! Jubilant, Bong-gu sets out to escape doggy heaven and embarks on a journey to reunite with his dad—an adventure that may hold unexpected dangers. Just as his dad once found him by some miracle, it is now Bong-gu’s turn to find his dad.
 
Will Bong-gu and his dad be reunited?

#IndieWorld #MyLittlePuppy #NintendoSwitch
